title: Society and the news
focus: 社会 · 经济 · 政府 · 政策 · 新闻 · 物价 · 失业 · 发展
body:
Words for talking about the news with your parents: the economy, prices, jobs and what the government is doing. Sentences recycle the money and housing words from L20 and L21.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 社会 | shèhuì | society | altar + gathering → community |
| 经济 | jīngjì | the economy | manage the world, relieve people |
| 政府 | zhèngfǔ | government | govern + official seat |
| 政策 | zhèngcè | policy (government or company) | govern + plan |
| 新闻 | xīnwén | the news | newly heard things |
| 物价 | wùjià | prices (of goods in general) / cost of living | goods + price → cost of living |
| 失业 | shīyè | to be unemployed / lose one's job | lose your occupation |
| 发展 | fāzhǎn | development / to develop (a city, economy) | sprout and unfold |

## Which word?

**物价 vs 涨价 (L9):** 物价 is the general price level (物价太高); 涨价 is one thing going up in price (咖啡又涨价了).

**政府 vs 政策:** 政府 is who governs; 政策 is the policy they make.

## Sentences

- 现在的社会，买房不贷款几乎不可能。 xiànzài de shèhuì, mǎi fáng bú dàikuǎn jīhū bù kěnéng: In today's society, buying a home without a loan is nearly impossible.
- 物价一直在涨，可是收入没变。 wùjià yìzhí zài zhǎng, kěshì shōurù méi biàn: Prices keep going up, but income hasn't changed.
- 政府出了新政策，帮年轻人租房。 zhèngfǔ chū le xīn zhèngcè, bāng niánqīngrén zūfáng: The government has brought out a new policy to help young people rent.
- 我爸一看新闻就有情绪。 wǒ bà yí kàn xīnwén jiù yǒu qíngxù: My dad gets worked up every time he watches the news.
- 这个政策对房租影响很大。 zhège zhèngcè duì fángzū yǐngxiǎng hěn dà: This policy has a big effect on rents.
- 这几年经济发展慢了，失业的人多了。 zhè jǐ nián jīngjì fāzhǎn màn le, shīyè de rén duō le: The economy has slowed these past few years, and more people are out of work.
- 新闻说政府要加税。 xīnwén shuō zhèngfǔ yào jiā shuì: The news says the government is going to raise taxes.
- 社会发展这么快，压力大也正常。 shèhuì fāzhǎn zhème kuài, yālì dà yě zhèngcháng: Society is developing so fast, it's normal to feel the pressure.

cards.Example: 现在社会节奏太快了。 xiànzài shèhuì jiézòu tài kuài le: Society moves too fast these days
cards.Notes: 社 shè earth-god altar, 示 altar radical (社区) + 会 huì gathering (开会, 会议) = the community gathered around the village altar. 社会问题 = social issue

cards.Example: 今年经济不太好，工作很难找。 jīnnián jīngjì bú tài hǎo, gōngzuò hěn nán zhǎo: The economy's bad this year and jobs are hard to find
cards.Notes: 经 jīng manage (经理, 经营) + 济 jì relieve, aid (救济) = short for 经世济民 'manage the world, relieve the people'. Also 'economical' in some phrases: 经济舱 = economy class

cards.Example: 政府最近出台了新的补贴。 zhèngfǔ zuìjìn chūtái le xīn de bǔtiē: The government just rolled out new subsidies
cards.Notes: 政 zhèng govern, 攵 hand with a stick: enforce (政治) + 府 fǔ official seat, 广 building (王府) = the seat of governing. 出台 = come out onto the 台 stage: roll out a policy

cards.Example: 这个政策对小企业影响很大。 zhège zhèngcè duì xiǎo qǐyè yǐngxiǎng hěn dà: This policy hits small businesses hard
cards.Notes: 政 zhèng govern (政府) + 策 cè plan, ⺮ bamboo slips (对策, 策划) = governing plan. 政策 = policy; 政治 = politics. Saying: 上有政策，下有对策 = rules from above, workarounds from below

cards.Example: 你看今天的新闻了吗？ nǐ kàn jīntiān de xīnwén le ma: Did you see today's news?
cards.Notes: 新 xīn new + 闻 wén hear: 耳 ear at the 门 door (in speech 闻 = smell) = newly heard things. 新闻 = news reports; 消息 = a piece of information or a message

cards.English: prices (of goods in general) / cost of living
cards.Example: 这两年物价涨得太厉害了。 zhè liǎng nián wùjià zhǎng de tài lìhai le: Prices have shot up these past two years
cards.Notes: 物 wù goods (购物, 礼物) + 价 jià price (价格, 价钱) = the price of goods. 物价 = the general price level; 价格 = the price of one item; 通胀 = inflation (胀 swell, 膨胀)

cards.English: to be unemployed / lose one's job
cards.Example: 他失业半年了，还在找工作。 tā shīyè bàn nián le, hái zài zhǎo gōngzuò: He's been out of work for six months and is still looking
cards.Notes: 失 shī lose (失去, 失望) + 业 yè occupation (职业, 毕业) = lose your occupation. 失业率 = unemployment rate; 被裁员 = laid off (裁 cut); 辞职 = quit

cards.Example: 这几年这个城市发展得很快。 zhè jǐ nián zhège chéngshì fāzhǎn de hěn kuài: This city has developed fast in the last few years
cards.Notes: 发 fā send out, sprout (发芽, 发生) + 展 zhǎn unfold (展开, 展览) = sprout and unfold. Same 展 as 进展. 发展中国家 = developing country

cards.English: In today's society, buying a home without a loan is nearly impossible.
cards.Hanzi: 现在的社会，买房不贷款几乎不可能。
cards.Pinyin: xiànzài de shèhuì, mǎi fáng bú dàikuǎn jīhū bù kěnéng.
cards.Notes: 社会 (L22) + 贷款 (L20). 几乎 = almost.

cards.English: Prices keep going up, but income hasn't changed.
cards.Hanzi: 物价一直在涨，可是收入没变。
cards.Pinyin: wùjià yìzhí zài zhǎng, kěshì shōurù méi biàn.
cards.Notes: 物价 (L22) + 收入 (L9). 物价 is prices in general.

cards.English: The government has brought out a new policy to help young people rent.
cards.Hanzi: 政府出了新政策，帮年轻人租房。
cards.Pinyin: zhèngfǔ chū le xīn zhèngcè, bāng niánqīngrén zūfáng.
cards.Notes: 政府 (L22) + 政策 (L22) + 租房 (L21). 出政策 = bring out a policy.

cards.English: My dad gets worked up every time he watches the news.
cards.Hanzi: 我爸一看新闻就有情绪。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ bà yí kàn xīnwén jiù yǒu qíngxù.
cards.Notes: 新闻 (L22) + 情绪 (L7). 一…就… = every time … then …

cards.English: This policy has a big effect on rents.
cards.Hanzi: 这个政策对房租影响很大。
cards.Pinyin: zhège zhèngcè duì fángzū yǐngxiǎng hěn dà.
cards.Notes: 政策 (L22) + 房租 (L21) + 影响 (L2). 对…影响很大 = big effect on …

cards.English: The economy has slowed these past few years, and more people are out of work.
cards.Hanzi: 这几年经济发展慢了，失业的人多了。
cards.Pinyin: zhè jǐ nián jīngjì fāzhǎn màn le, shīyè de rén duō le.

cards.English: The news says the government is going to raise taxes.
cards.Pinyin: xīnwén shuō zhèngfǔ yào jiā shuì.
cards.Notes: 新闻 (L22) + 政府 (L22) + 税 (L20). 加税 = raise taxes.

cards.English: Society is developing so fast, it's normal to feel the pressure.
cards.Hanzi: 社会发展这么快，压力大也正常。
cards.Pinyin: shèhuì fāzhǎn zhème kuài, yālì dà yě zhèngcháng.
